title: Member of Technical Staff - Full Stack
description:
Who We Are

Hyperbolic Labs is on a mission to democratize AI by breaking down the barriers to computing power with our Open-Access AI Cloud. By making better use of idle computing resources across the globe, we offer an innovative GPU marketplace and AI inference service that promise affordability and accessibility for all. As pioneers at the intersection of AI and open-source technology, we believe in an open future where AI innovation is limited only by imagination, not by access to resources. We're looking for forward-thinking individuals who share our passion for making AI universally accessible, secure, and affordable. Join us in building a platform that empowers innovators everywhere to turn their visionary AI projects into reality.

About the Role

As a Full Stack Engineer at Hyperbolic Labs, you’ll work closely with our Product and Engineering teams to design, build, and scale end-to-end applications that power our AI cloud platform. You’ll contribute across the stack — from infrastructure and backend systems to intuitive frontend interfaces — helping us deliver a seamless experience for our GPU marketplace, inference tools, and platform services.

In this role, you’ll be deeply involved in shaping both our product and the technology behind it. You’ll architect scalable systems, implement new features, and continuously improve our development practices to support rapid growth. This is a high-impact role where you’ll collaborate with talented engineers to build the backbone of Hyperbolic’s core products.

Who You Are

•
8+ years of experience in full-stack development, preferably in high-growth product environments.

•
Expert in Node.JS, TypeScript, with some Python fluency for backend systems

•
Experience with Drizzle ORM, Postgres, and Vercel and Github-based CI/CD pipelines.

•
Strong product sense — you care about user experience as much as technical elegance.

•
Effective communicator who thrives in fast-paced, cross-functional teams.

•
Demonstrated experience shipping production-ready features end-to-end.

•
Skilled in structuring, running, and interpreting A/B and multivariate experiments to inform data-driven product decisions.

•
Experience designing and building large-scale applications, from data modeling and API design to front-end architecture.

Preferred Qualifications

•
Strong Python expertise and familiarity with scripting for automation or integration.

•
Experience working on AI developer tools or at-scale distributed systems.

•
Experience with Supabase, Figma, or design collaboration workflows.

•
Familiarity with A/B testing and feature flag systems (PostHog).

•
Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) and AI integration patterns.

•
Previous leadership or mentorship experience within engineering teams.

•
Passion for building tools that empower developers and accelerate innovation.

Hyperbolic is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Capital Markets Lead
description:
Who We Are

Hyperbolic Labs is on a mission to democratize AI by breaking down the barriers to computing power with our Open-Access AI Cloud. By making better use of idle computing resources across the globe, we offer an innovative GPU marketplace and AI inference service that promise affordability and accessibility for all. As pioneers at the intersection of AI and open-source technology, we believe in an open future where AI innovation is limited only by imagination, not by access to resources. We're looking for forward-thinking individuals who share our passion for making AI universally accessible, secure, and affordable. Join us in building a platform that empowers innovators everywhere to turn their visionary AI projects into reality.

About the Role

You'll work directly with the Head of Finance and CEO to raise the capital that funds our compute supply, across conventional facilities and structures that don't have a standard playbook yet. Compute is an unusual asset class. It has contracted cash flows, a real residual value, a depreciation curve nobody agrees on, and a lender base that is still forming an opinion about it. You'll build the financing architecture around it, and make the case to a credit committee that our receivables are money good. This is a builder's seat, not a maintenance seat — there is no existing facility to administer, and you will originate the first ones.

You'll originate and structure debt capital to fund vendor down payments and capacity commitments, spanning bank revolvers, private credit and non-bank facilities, receivables- and contract-backed structures, SPV and project-style financings, and vendor and equipment financing. You'll own the lender and investor relationship map, run raises end to end from positioning through definitive documentation, and sit in the redlines on covenants, lien priority, DACA mechanics, borrowing base definitions, and advance rates. You'll own the financing side of our contract-level model and bring leadership a defensible recommendation rather than a menu, support the concurrent equity round without letting the debt and equity tracks collide, manage post-close lender reporting and compliance, and work closely with the teams negotiating vendor supply and customer contracts so that what we sign is financeable.

In your first 90 days, you'll know our unit economics and contract mechanics, have a mapped and prioritized lender universe, and have first meetings underway. By six months, you'll have a term sheet in hand for a facility that funds vendor down payments on terms we'd sign again. By twelve months, capital is no longer the constraint on how much capacity we can commit to.

Who You Are

•
5+ years in capital markets, corporate development, or institutional fundraising; 10+ preferred

•
You have raised institutional capital before — specifically from institutional LPs for a hedge fund, private equity firm, or venture capital firm — and you can name the relationships you'd bring

•
Investment bank capital markets experience, ideally debt: DCM, leveraged finance, structured finance, private capital markets, or a financial sponsors group

•
Existing relationships with bank, non-bank, and private credit lenders active in the AI space

•
Real fluency in credit documentation and structure — comfortable arguing about first-lien vs. second-lien, intercreditor terms, cash sweeps, and what a lender actually means when they ask for control over an account

•
Strong financial modeling skills; you can build the facility model yourself and defend every assumption in it

•
Comfortable operating with ambiguity, a small team, and no analyst bench

Preferred Qualifications

•
You've raised a Series B or Series C at a startup — as an operator, not an advisor

•
Exposure to asset-backed, equipment, infrastructure, or project finance

•
Familiarity with AI infrastructure, data centers, semiconductors, or energy — or a demonstrated ability to get up the curve on a technical market fast

Hyperbolic is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Quantitative Researcher
description:
Who We Are

Hyperbolic Labs is on a mission to democratize AI by breaking down the barriers to computing power with our Open-Access AI Cloud. By making better use of idle computing resources across the globe, we offer an innovative GPU marketplace and AI inference service that promise affordability and accessibility for all. As pioneers at the intersection of AI and open-source technology, we believe in an open future where AI innovation is limited only by imagination, not by access to resources. We're looking for forward-thinking individuals who share our passion for making AI universally accessible, secure, and affordable. Join us in building a platform that empowers innovators everywhere to turn their visionary AI projects into reality.

About the Role

Compute is becoming a traded asset, and almost none of the market structure exists yet. There is no settled forward curve, no standard contract, no consensus on how to price optionality on a GPU-hour. We're building the financial layer of our marketplace, and we're looking for a Quantitative Researcher to own the modeling behind it.

You'll build the pricing models that set spot and term rates dynamically across GPU types and regions, hedge our compute portfolio using both conventional derivatives and non-traditional instruments, and design the options and futures structures that let customers and suppliers transfer compute risk. You'll also be our read on the market — where pricing is heading, what's tradable, and what we should be building next. This is early, unmapped work: you'll be defining the methodology rather than applying an existing one.

Who You Are

•
5+ years in quantitative research, trading, or structuring, with hands-on experience building pricing or risk models that were actually traded on, not just backtested

•
Deep fluency in derivatives pricing and hedging — options, futures, forwards — and the ability to reason about instruments where no liquid market or clean volatility surface exists

•
Experience constructing hedges for a portfolio of physical or contracted assets, using both conventional derivatives and non-standard instruments

•
Dynamic pricing expertise: building models that set spot and term prices from supply, demand, and inventory signals in near real time

•
Strong programming skills in Python and comfort working directly with messy production data rather than a curated research dataset

•
Ability to structure new financial products from first principles, including contract design, settlement mechanics, and the assumptions underneath them

•
Clear communicator who can defend a model to finance, engineering, and commercial stakeholders and translate output into a decision

•
Comfortable operating with ambiguity, incomplete data, and no established playbook for the asset class

Preferred Qualifications

•
Experience in commodities, power, or energy markets — the closest existing analogue to compute, with similar delivery, storage, and locational constraints

•
Background in market making, systematic trading, or structuring at a hedge fund, prop shop, bank, or exchange

•
Exposure to nascent or illiquid markets where you had to build the curve rather than consume it

•
Familiarity with GPU compute, AI infrastructure economics, or data center cost structures

•
Experience with crypto or other markets where compute, hashrate, or energy was the underlying

•
Advanced degree in a quantitative field, or equivalent demonstrated depth

Strong understanding of committed capacity, usage-based pricing, SLAs, security obligations, indemnities, liability caps, and termination economics.

•
Able to compare interconnected supplier and customer agreements, identify mismatched obligations, and develop practical risk mitigations.

•
Commercial, collaborative, and comfortable making sound decisions in a fast-moving environment.

•
Experience at a neocloud, GPU cloud, public-cloud provider, data-center operator, high-performance computing company, or infrastructure marketplace.

•
Experience with channel, reseller, marketplace, referral, capacity-sharing, or other non-standard commercial arrangements.

•
Experience supporting an early-stage company across commercial, corporate, regulatory, and product matters.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Hyperbolic Labs is on a mission to democratize AI by breaking down the barriers to computing power with our Open-Access AI Cloud. By making better use of idle computing resources across the globe, we offer an innovative GPU marketplace and AI inference service that promise affordability and accessibility for all. As pioneers at the intersection of AI and open-source technology, we believe in an open future where AI innovation is limited only by imagination, not by access to resources. We're looking for forward-thinking individuals who share our passion for making AI universally accessible, secure, and affordable. Join us in building a platform that empowers innovators everywhere to turn their visionary AI projects into reality.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is Hyperbolic's first dedicated Data Engineer, and you will build our data infrastructure from 0 to 1. You'll be one half of a two-person data team, working alongside our data analyst, which means a high degree of autonomy and a direct line to impact. Today our product engineers maintain the data stack on top of their day jobs. You will take ownership of the data warehouse, the pipelines that feed it, and the tooling that keeps it healthy.

The timing matters. As we launch new products like inference, our data volume will grow fast, we will add more data sources, and more teams will rely on BI and reporting. Scrappy processes and off-the-shelf tools won't keep up at that scale, and you will build what comes next.

You will sit between our data analysts and engineering, partnering with both to make sure the right data is reliable, fast, and cost-efficient to use.

Our current data stack includes Redshift, Postgres, and Hex, with Polytomic for ingestion.

WHO YOU ARE

•
Track record of independently building and maintaining a data warehouse that ingests and aggregates data from multiple sources using industry-standard tooling

•
Experience designing data models for new business lines, figuring out what to model and how as new products (like spot and inference) come online

•
Experience ensuring data reliability and quality through testing, documentation, and governance

•
Familiarity with data lakes and data warehouses, and when to use each

•
Deep knowledge of Postgres, including partitioning, data archival, and moving large datasets

•
Experience working with large datasets

•
Experience supporting production systems: monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning

•
Strong communication skills, with the judgment to push back on requests that would add tech debt and explain why

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

•
Familiarity with the AWS ecosystem (this can be learned on the job)

•
DBA experience

•
Experience setting up CI/CD for data pipelines

•
Background in GPU infrastructure, cloud computing, or AI infrastructure

•
Experience at an early-stage, high-growth technical company

Hyperbolic is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Head of Talent
description:
Who We Are

Hyperbolic Labs is on a mission to democratize AI by breaking down the barriers to computing power with our Open-Access AI Cloud. By making better use of idle computing resources across the globe, we offer an innovative GPU marketplace and AI inference service that promise affordability and accessibility for all. As pioneers at the intersection of AI and open-source technology, we believe in an open future where AI innovation is limited only by imagination, not by access to resources. We're looking for forward-thinking individuals who share our passion for making AI universally accessible, secure, and affordable. Join us in building a platform that empowers innovators everywhere to turn their visionary AI projects into reality.

About the Role

Hyperbolic is seeking a hands-on Head of Talent to refine the systems and processes behind our next stage of growth from ~30 to ~70-100 employees in the next 6-12 months. This role will shape what Hyperbolic looks like and where our future holds.

Working directly with our founders and leadership team, you will define hiring priorities, personally lead critical searches, and build a rigorous, scalable recruiting engine. This is a player-coach role for someone who can attract exceptional technical and business talent while creating the systems that help us hire with speed and quality.

What You Will Do

•
Own full-cycle recruiting across all departments.

•
Translate company goals, mission and culture into clear hiring priorities, candidate profiles, and search strategies.

•
Personally source, assess, and close top talent.

•
Build the talent roadmap to help Hyperbolic scale and help balance hiring priorities across different functions.

•
Design end-to-end talent engine with structured interviews, scorecards, and decision frameworks.

•
Serve as a trusted partner to the founders and hiring managers on candidate strategy, leveling, and offer construction

•
Stand up the tooling, data, and pipeline visibility we need to run 60+ hires per year without dropping quality

•
Manage the recruiting team, recruiting resources and hiring partners efficiently.

•
Build Hyperbolic’s employer brand and make Hyperbolic an exciting place to work at.

Who You Are

•
You have 10+ years of recruiting experience, including ownership of a recruiting function in a high-growth company.

•
You have successfully hired technical talent across infrastructure, distributed systems, AI/ML, cloud, or developer tools.

•
You are a hands-on recruiter who enjoys sourcing and closing, not only managing.

•
You have built or meaningfully improved recruiting processes, systems, and metrics.

•
You can understand complex technology and engage credibly with senior technical candidates.

•
You use data and market intelligence to improve hiring decisions.

•
You exercise strong judgment and can challenge leaders constructively.

•
You thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments and take ownership from strategy through execution.

Preferred Qualifications

•
Experience at a neocloud, hyperscaler, AI lab, GPU cloud, or infrastructure company.

•
Experience as the first or early Talent hire at a venture-backed startup.

•
A strong network across AI and infrastructure talent.
